Leonidakit est un site de fans consacré: Leonidakit is a fan site about GTA VI: an interactive map of Leonida, pages on vehicles, weapons, places and characters, a calculator to plan purchases, budget and play time, and Léo, an assistant that answers questions about the game.
Chaque information porte un statut (Offi: Every piece of information has a status (Official, Seen in media, Community identification, Series benchmark, To be confirmed) and its source; nothing is made up.
Gratuit, sans compte et sans cookie, en: Free, no account and no cookies, in 5 languages, run by an individual and independent of both Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive.

Trois règles simples, pour que ton publi: Three simple rules, so your audience knows where each thing comes from.
Cite la source de Rockstar quand la fich: Cite Rockstar’s source when the page gives one: it is on the page’s “Source” line, or under “Sources for this file” for a place or a character. Leonidakit only passes it on.
Pour citer le site, écris « Leonidakit »: To cite the site, write “Leonidakit” with a link to the page the information comes from: the map, the calculator and every vehicle, weapon or place page have their own address.
Un point à confirmer: A point still to be confirmed
Une « Identification communautaire » ou: A “Community identification” or a point marked “To be confirmed” is not an announcement: present it as such, with its status.
Exemple : « Source : Leonidakit, carte i: Example: “Source: Leonidakit, interactive map of Leonida (leonidakit.com/en/carte.html)”.

Leonidakit n’est ni affilié à Rockstar G: Leonidakit is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and GTA VI belong to them.
Aucun contenu du site n’est payé par qui: No content on the site is paid for by anyone. Talking with the press, a creator or a brand never changes a status, a source or a figure.
